method: Independent native-original review, 2x or 3x face/hand/prop crops, full shoulder-elbow-wrist chains traced in original, direct canonical portrait comparison, current lesson and relevant exercise source verification.

checks.anatomyAndContact: Four complete arm chains: Farah braces desk and chair; Demir rests one hand by the keyboard and the other on the desk. All contacts and thumb sides remain coherent at magnification.
checks.displayLegibilityAndSource: The large comparison states the same reading yields scores three percentage points apart, notebook retrained v2 versus dashboard cached v1, and directs a cache-version check. This matches the stale IndexedDB epilogue.
checks.identityExpressionAndStory: The shared surprised exchange is specific and both canonical faces remain distinct.
checks.palette: Muted sage, charcoal and aged brass with warm skin and restrained lighting.
checks.perspectiveAndOperator: Readable physical display fronts with consistent text plane and plausible operator orientation.
checks.largeDisplayRule: Essential lesson information is large and clear, using the available scene space rather than a tiny rear console.
